Subject: Connector commission & registration proposal for Novus pilot

Hi Emma —

Great to meet yesterday. Attached is a starter proposal for the Novus connector pilot and how we’d handle partner economics and lead registration. High-level: 

- Revenue share: 15% of Redwood-recognized revenue attributable to Novus-sourced deals in year 1, 12% year 2; paid out quarterly after invoice.
- Registration window: partners must register a lead within 5 business days of first contact to receive lead protection; Redwood to approve registrations within 7 business days.
- Demo suppression policy: if Redwood delivers a demo to the registered prospect, Novus must not run independent paid outreach for 30 days without notifying Redwood; otherwise commission eligibility is reduced.
- Gating: commission payments are gated to a production integration milestone (P1) and first paid invoice. Clawback applies if customer churns or credits occur in the first 12 months.

Attached: redwood_draft_sow_novus.pdf and commission_matrix_novus.csv. Please review and tell us which items you want to discuss in procurement/legal.

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, we’ll circulate a short mutual action plan and a tailored reseller appendix for Novus.

Cheers,
Ben

Hi Emma —

Great questions. Short answers: 

- Payment timing: Redwood issues commission payments to Novus on a monthly payout schedule (we reconcile monthly), with standard payment terms net-30 from the date Redwood invoices the customer. If an invoice is disputed or credited, the related commission is withheld until resolution. We can also support quarterly remits if Novus prefers.

- Qualified registration: a registration is an individual prospect record with a verified company domain + validated point of contact (email or phone). We treat an opportunity as "Novus-sourced" when Novus is the first to document substantive commercial outreach (discovery, POC request). We’ll share a one-pager that maps MQL->SQL->Opp for registration purposes.

- Demo suppression/co-marketing: 30 days is our baseline to avoid conflicting outreach. Exceptions for co-branded campaigns are allowed if agreed in advance in writing and captured on the registration; we can add a clause that allows mutual approval for joint campaigns.

Attaching a mutual_action_plan_novus.xlsx with proposed milestone gates (P1: sandbox integration + successful token exchange; P2: production go-live). Commission becomes payable after P1 + first paid invoice.

If this model works, Hannah can coordinate legal redlines and procurement terms.

Best,
Ben

Hi all —

Thanks for the fast review. Proposed plan to move forward: 

1) Commercials: Redwood confirms the following: commission eligibility is calculated on Redwood net-recognized revenue after any reseller discounts; we can accept net-45 on partner commission remits for the pilot (one-time exception) provided the partner signs a standard remittance schedule. Clawback: 12 months from the first paid invoice.

2) Registration & demo suppression: registration window is 7 business days from first substantive contact for Novus to claim protection; Redwood will respond to registration requests within 5 business days. Demo suppression baseline is 30 days; if Novus wants to run a joint or co-branded campaign inside that window, please request approval on the registration form and we will document it. Unapproved partner outreach in the suppression window reduces commission by 50% for that deal.

3) Payment & gating: commissions are gated to P1 (sandbox integration + successful token exchange) and the first paid invoice. We will invoice customers directly. Payment reconciliation will be monthly and remitted within 45 days for this pilot.

4) Next artifacts: attaching partner_terms_redlines_v2.pdf with our baseline redlines for your counsel to review. Also linking the HubSpot deal and DocuSign template for your legal/procurement.

Action items: 
- Novus Procurement: confirm PO timing and whether you will pursue the 10% reseller discount (if you do, we will update the commission calculation schedule).
- Novus Legal: propose two times for a contract redline call this week.
- Ben/Hannah: we’ll consolidate feedback and send a final pilot appendix by EOD Friday.

If everyone is aligned, we can lock the mutual action plan and get the PO issued.

Thanks,
